cohort: Eighty women who experienced assisted vaginal birth at Dr Soetomo Hospital, Indonesia, divided into two groups (with and without 24-hour catheterization).
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of urinary retention between women who received 24-hour catheterization and those who did not after assisted vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: No significant difference in urinary retention occurred in assisted vaginal delivery cases with and without 24-hour catheterization.
